enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Extends legs. Curls up. Turns onto back. Snores. Moves arm. Turns to left side again. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to right side. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, showering and washing up
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Gets out of bed. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on shower. Adjusts water. Steps into shower. Washes body. Shampoos hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries body. Wraps towel. Turns on tap. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast (toast and coffee)
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out bread, butter, and milk. Closes refrigerator. Places bread on counter. Opens bread bag. Takes out two slices. Puts slices in toaster. Presses toaster lever. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Takes out plate and mug. Pours water into mug. Adds coffee. Stirs. Takes toast out of toaster. Puts on plate. Spreads butter. Sits at table. Eats toast and drinks coffee.

enriched_activities.activity: Weekend morning chores: tidying up and vacuuming the living room
enriched_activities.desc: Walks into living room. Picks up items from floor. Places items on shelves. Fluffs pillows. Folds blankets. Picks up vacuum cleaner. Plugs in vacuum. Turns on vacuum. Vacuums floor. Moves furniture. Vacuums under furniture. Turns off vacuum. Unplugs vacuum. Wraps cord. Puts vacuum away. Wipes surfaces. Dusts shelves. Throws away trash. Opens window. Closes window.

Leaves house. Walks to bus stop. Rides bus to grocery store. Enters store. Picks up shopping cart. Pushes cart. Selects fruits. Selects vegetables. Places in cart. Selects milk. Selects cheese. Places in cart. Selects chicken. Selects beef. Places in cart. Walks to checkout. Pays cashier. Bags groceries. Returns home by bus. Enters house.

enriched_activities.activity: Putting away groceries and organising the refrigerator
enriched_activities.desc: Places grocery bags on counter. Opens refrigerator. Takes out items from bags. Places items in refrigerator. Rearranges shelves. Checks expiration dates. Throws away old items. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboards. Places dry goods in cupboards. Closes cupboards. Folds reusable bags. Stores bags. Wipes counter. Throws away packaging. Opens refrigerator again. Takes out a drink. Closes refrigerator. Drinks.

enriched_activities.activity: Doing laundry with the washing machine
enriched_activities.desc: Collects laundry basket. Carries to bathroom. Opens washing machine. Sorts clothes. Loads clothes into washing machine. Adds detergent. Closes washing machine. Turns on washing machine. Selects cycle. Presses start. Waits. Checks time. Checks washing machine. Opens washing machine. Takes out wet clothes. Places in dryer. Adds dryer sheet. Closes dryer. Turns on dryer. Sets timer.

enriched_activities.activity: Moving laundry to the dryer and folding clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Opens washing machine. Takes out wet clothes. Places in dryer. Adds dryer sheet. Closes dryer. Turns on dryer. Sets timer. Opens dryer. Takes out dry clothes. Folds clothes. Stacks folded clothes. Puts clothes in drawer.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out lettuce, tomatoes, cheese, and ham. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out bread. Takes out plate. Takes out knife. Places bread on cutting board. Spreads mayonnaise. Places lettuce, tomato, cheese, and ham on bread. Closes sandwich. Cuts sandwich in half. Places on plate. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Washes dishes. Puts dishes in drying rack.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing in the heat: watching TV and reading with a cool drink
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Selects program. Watches TV. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns pages. Picks up drink. Sips drink. Puts down drink. Continues reading. Watches TV. Puts book down. Picks up remote. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Afternoon nap with the fan on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on fan. Lies on bed. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Extends legs. Curls up. Turns onto back. Snores. Moves arm. Turns to left side again. Wakes up. Sits up. Turns off fan. Stands up. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Online continuing education and professional reading on the computer
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens browser. Logs into course. Reads materials. Takes notes. Watches video. Pauses video. Writes notes. Resumes video. Reads article. Highlights text. Takes more notes. Checks email. Replies to email. Closes browser. Turns off computer. Stands up. Walks to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time browsing the phone and listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up phone. Unlocks phone. Opens music app. Selects playlist. Plays music. Puts phone down. Listens to music. Picks up phone. Scrolls through social media. Reads posts. Likes posts. Watches video. Puts phone down. Listens to music. Checks messages. Replies to messages. Puts phone down. Stands up. Walks to kitchen.

Walks into kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out chicken and vegetables. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out rice, pot, and pan. Washes vegetables. Cuts vegetables. Turns on stove. Pours oil in pan. Adds chicken. Cooks chicken. Adds vegetables. Cooks vegetables. Cooks rice. Sets table. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Washes dishes. Puts dishes in drying rack.

Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Opens streaming app. Selects movie. Plays movie. Watches movie. Pauses movie. Gets up. Walks to kitchen. Takes out snack. Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Resumes movie. Watches movie. Eats snack. Finishes movie. Turns off TV. Stands up. Walks to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening wash and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Uses toilet. Flushes. Turns on tap. Washes face. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Takes off clothes. Steps into shower. Washes body. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries body. Puts on pajamas. Turns off light. Walks to bedroom. Gets into bed.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading in bed with the desk lamp on
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Turns on desk lamp. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns pages. Adjusts pillow. Sits up. Reads more. Turns pages. Lies down. Reads more. Turns pages. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off desk lamp. Closes eyes. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Sleeps.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Extends legs. Curls up. Turns onto back. Snores. Moves arm. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to left side again. Pulls blanket up. Remains asleep.
